boost.guide_all_title: 🌐 All Purposes of DNS (Gaming, Security, Privacy & Web Speed)
boost.guide_all: DNS (Domain Name System) is the internet's phonebook: it translates domain names (Steam SDR relays, Workshop FastDL map mirrors, Discord voice servers, and websites) into IP addresses before your PC can connect. Beyond speed, specialized DNS resolvers also provide: (1) Bypassing overloaded or broken ISP DNS resolvers; (2) Malware & phishing domain blocking at the network layer (Quad9 9.9.9.9); (3) Blocking background ad-trackers and telemetry spikes while gaming (AdGuard 94.140.14.14); and (4) Privacy protection against ISP DNS logging and NXDOMAIN hijacking.
boost.guide_pros:
• Faster initial handshakes with Steam API, Workshop FastDL custom map mirrors, Discord voice gateways, and everyday web browsing.
• Eliminates ISP DNS lookup timeouts, regional DNS outages, and domain resolution jitter.
• Optional zero-overhead security filtering (Quad9) or background telemetry/ad-tracker blocking (AdGuard).
• Changes your network adapter's DNS with the standard Windows 'netsh' command (needs Administrator). One click restores automatic DNS (DHCP).
boost.guide_cons_title: ⚠️ DNS Optimizer CONS & Honest Limitations (What To Know)
boost.guide_cons:
• Does NOT lower raw in-game UDP ping once already connected: After your PC resolves a domain (or connects directly to a server IP like 74.91.124.21:27015), live game packets travel directly over UDP without querying DNS.
• Unbenchmarked distant DNS can route to farther CDN mirrors: Picking a DNS server physically far from your region without benchmarking first can cause Steam/FastDL CDNs to pick a non-local download mirror. Always click '⚡ Benchmark All DNS Servers' first!
• Hotel / School / Corporate Captive Portals: Public Wi-Fi login pages sometimes require the router's default local DNS. If a public Wi-Fi login page doesn't load, simply click '↺ Restore ISP Default (DHCP)'.
boost.guide_ram_title: 🚫 Why this app does not use 'RAM cleaners'
boost.guide_ram: Aggressive RAM cleaners (EmptyWorkingSet / Standby List purgers) forcibly evict active memory pages used by CS2, Discord, and browsers into slow disk pagefile.sys — causing Hard Page Fault stutters and random app/browser crashes. CS2 Command Center strictly avoids memory purging and instead uses safe Win32 HIGH_PRIORITY_CLASS thread scheduling so other programs keep running normally.

mpo.why_title: ❓  WHY IS GPU MPO DIAGNOSTICS IN CS2 COMMAND CENTER?
mpo.why:
Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO) is a Windows WDDM hardware presentation feature that allows the GPU display engine to composite desktop windows (such as Discord, web browsers, or Spotify) and 3D games directly on separate hardware planes without routing through the Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) composition swapchain.

WHY IT CAUSES SEVERE ISSUES IN CS2 & WINDOWS:
• Alt-Tab Black Screen & Freezes: When switching focus between CS2 and desktop windows, MPO hardware plane handshakes frequently desynchronize. This causes 1 to 3-second black screens, temporary display freezing, or game crashes.
• AMD Radeon Driver Timeouts: On AMD systems (RDNA 1/2/3/4), MPO is widely documented to trigger 'AMD Driver Timeout' crash dialogs (amdkmdag.sys) when running hardware-accelerated video or Discord on a secondary display while CS2 is in-match.
• NVIDIA Driver Crashes & Checkerboard Glitches: On NVIDIA GeForce (RTX/GTX), MPO causes Chromium/Discord checkerboard artifacting, G-Sync stutter, and display flickering. This issue became so widespread that NVIDIA officially published Support Article #5152 providing their official 'mpo_disable.reg' registry fix.
• Mixed-Refresh Rate Desync: If your primary CS2 monitor runs at 144Hz / 240Hz / 360Hz and your secondary monitor runs at 60Hz, MPO often caps or stutters the high-refresh monitor whenever background animations or video occur on the other display.

⭐ ESSENTIAL FIRST STEP: CLEAN DRIVER REINSTALL VIA DDU (BEFORE TOUCHING MPO)
Before modifying or disabling Multi-Plane Overlay in the registry, you should ALWAYS first perform a complete Display Driver Uninstaller (DDU) wipe in Windows Safe Mode followed by a fresh installation of the latest WHQL graphics driver.

Many driver timeouts, Alt-Tab freezes, and black screens are caused by corrupted driver cache, shader cache mismatch, or dirty driver updates—NOT MPO itself. Test your system after the DDU reinstall first; if your issue is completely resolved, you do NOT need to touch or disable MPO!

• Step 1: Download the latest WHQL graphics driver from AMD/NVIDIA and download DDU (wagnardsoft.com).
• Step 2: Disconnect your internet connection (unplug Ethernet or disable Wi-Fi) to prevent Windows Update from auto-installing generic drivers.
• Step 3: Boot into Windows Safe Mode, launch DDU, and choose 'Clean and restart'.
• Step 4: After rebooting into normal Windows, install your freshly downloaded driver, restart, and reconnect internet.
• Step 5: Check if CS2 runs smoothly. If your problem is solved, leave MPO enabled at Windows default!

⚠️ WHY AVOID AMD CLEANUP UTILITY / MANUFACTURER UNINSTALLERS:
Manufacturer tools such as AMD Cleanup Utility (AMDCleanupUtility.exe) aggressively purge ALL AMD drivers from the system, including critical AMD Chipset drivers, PCIe root drivers, and USB host controller drivers. This frequently causes USB mouse/keyboard input loss or Windows Safe Mode PIN sign-in failure loops. DDU is isolated specifically to graphics display drivers, making it vastly safer.

WHEN SHOULD YOU DISABLE MPO?
Only proceed with disabling MPO if you have ALREADY performed a clean DDU driver wipe and you STILL continue to experience Alt-Tab black screens, multi-monitor refresh rate desync, or Discord/browser checkerboard glitches.

WHY THIS TAB IS IN CS2 COMMAND CENTER:
Many CS2 players blame game updates, config files, or their hardware for these crashes and black screens. This dedicated troubleshooter shows live, read-only diagnostics for AMD, NVIDIA, and Intel GPUs, explains the exact symptoms, and provides the registry commands to copy, with 1-click clipboard helpers.

🔒 READ-ONLY: CS2 Command Center does not modify your display driver or registry automatically. You have full visibility and control to decide whether disabling MPO is right for your PC setup.
mpo.considerations:
Multi-Plane Overlay is enabled by default in Windows. Before modifying this setting, first perform a DDU + clean GPU driver reinstall to see if it fixes your issue:
• Windows Default (Enabled): Standard behavior. Composites 2D windows and 3D games directly without running through the DWM swapchain.
• Optional Modification (Disabled): Recommended ONLY IF clean DDU driver reinstall did not resolve your Alt-Tab black screens, Discord/browser checkerboard artifacts, AMD Driver Timeouts, or multi-monitor refresh rate desync.
mpo.technical:
Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO) is a Windows WDDM hardware presentation feature that allows the GPU display pipeline to composite 2D window elements (Discord, web browsers, video players) and 3D games on independent hardware planes without running through the Desktop Window Manager (DWM) composition swapchain.

Multi-GPU Vendor Impact:
• AMD Radeon: Frequently triggers 1-3 second black screen flickers when Alt-Tabbing, 'AMD Driver Timeout' (amdkmdag.sys) crash dialogs, or multi-monitor stutter when running different refresh rates (e.g. 240Hz/144Hz + 60Hz).
• NVIDIA GeForce: Known to cause G-Sync multi-monitor stutter, intermittent black screen flickers, and Chromium / Discord checkerboard rendering artifacts (the reason NVIDIA officially released their 'mpo_disable.reg' patch).
• Intel Arc / Iris: Causes DWM display flickering and judder during borderless-to-fullscreen transitions.
mpo.tradeoffs: Disabling MPO causes Windows to route all windowed rendering through standard DWM desktop composition. This may slightly increase idle GPU memory clocks and power draw (+2W to 5W) on desktop when watching hardware-accelerated video. It does not introduce input latency into games.
mpo.summary:
• ⚠️ FIRST RECOMMENDATION: Always perform a clean GPU driver reinstall using DDU in Safe Mode first! Check if that resolves your stutter or black screen before modifying MPO.
• If your PC runs smoothly with zero black flickers or driver timeouts: Keeping Windows Default (Enabled) is completely normal.
• If you did DDU and still experience Alt-Tab black screens, Discord checkerboards, or multi-monitor refresh desync: Disabling MPO via the registry is the workaround NVIDIA documents for these symptoms (reversible).
mpo.diy:
METHOD 1: Safe 1-Click Clipboard Command (Administrator Command Prompt / PowerShell)
1. Click the '📋 Copy Disable MPO Command' button below.
2. Press [Win + X] and select 'Terminal (Admin)' or 'Command Prompt (Admin)'.
3. Paste the command and press Enter.
4. Restart your PC for the graphics driver to reload.

METHOD 2: Manual Windows Registry Editor (Regedit)
1. Press [Win + R], type 'regedit', and press Enter.
2. Navigate to: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers
3. To Disable MPO: Right-click GraphicsDrivers -> New -> DWORD (32-bit) Value -> Name: DisableOverlays -> Value data: 1.
4. To Re-Enable MPO (Default): Right-click DisableOverlays -> Delete (or set value to 0).
5. Restart your PC.
